description: This file defines the class HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_NameSync, which performs validation and synchronization of the 'name' attribute with the 'id' attribute in HTML elements for HTMLPurifier. It ensures that if a 'name' is present and matches an 'id', it is passed through; otherwise, it validates the 'name' attribute as an HTML ID.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_NameSync
classes.description: A class that validates and synchronizes the 'name' attribute with the 'id' attribute in HTML tags, ensuring consistency and validity according to HTML rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object and sets up the ID attribute definition used for validation.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms the element attributes by validating the 'name' attribute and synchronizing it with 'id' if applicable.
